run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum distance between two numbers in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify minimum distance calculation
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks previous index and computes minimum distance between two values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases where x or y is missing from the array
